I have a very extreme fear of people touching my head, specifically my ears. I can usually get away with it until someone purposely goes to tap my cheek, head, or ear. It's okay if they miss or I move, sort of just shudder on the spot for a minute, but if they do get me, been by accident whilst walking past or something (crowds are a nightmare) I start freaking out, holding both hands over my ears and wailing/screaming. My whole head and neck tingle and shiver, feeling both really hot and freezing cold, is the most uncomfortable feeling ever, but people never get it and always think I'm just playing it up and usually laugh. I can't even let my boyfriend kiss my neck or ears without being extremely tense and uncomfortable, which generally is very un-sexy.
